name: app-blue-and-white-crypto-wallet-screens-tilted-with-fingerprint-security
title: Blue Crypto Wallet Screens with Fingerprint
whatItIs: A tilted collage of crypto wallet screens with a blue gradient balance header, movers and watchlist lists with coloured sparklines, an assets list, a blue fingerprint security screen and a Convert Bitcoin screen with a keypad and blue Preview Conversion button.
whatItMeans: Cobalt blue on white feels trustworthy, and the giant fingerprint makes security tangible.
techniques: Large fingerprint graphic on the security screen

vocabulary.definition: A screen prompting fingerprint or face verification.
A list of assets with the biggest price changes.
A button showing a result before confirming an action.
